{{Translated title}} [[File:Pokémon hunters HZ035.png|thumb|250px|Pokémon hunters]] The (Japanese: '''ポケモンハンター''' ''Pokémon hunters'') are [[character of the day|characters of the day]] who appeared in ''[[HZ035|The Wild Pair, Friede and Cap!]]''. They capture "cute" {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} for their boss. ==Pokémon== ===Boss=== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Boss |pkmn=Avalugg |type1=Ice |img=Pokémon hunter Avalugg.png |epnum=HZ035 |epname=The Wild Pair, Friede and Cap! |vajp= |vaen= |desc={{p|Avalugg}} is the boss's only known Pokémon. It was used to threaten the Pokémon the hunters had captured to prevent [[Friede]], [[Liko]], and [[Roy]] from interfering. It was defeated when [[Captain Pikachu]] attacked it with {{m|Thunder Punch}}. Avalugg's only known move is {{m|Blizzard}}.}} ===Hunters=== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Hunter |pkmn=Omastar |type1=Rock |type2=Water |img=Pokémon hunter Toxtricity Mudsdale Omastar.png |epnum=HZ035 |epname=The Wild Pair, Friede and Cap! |vajp= |vaen= |desc={{p|Omastar}} is one of the hunter's only known Pokémon. It was used to battle against [[Friede]], [[Liko]], and [[Roy]], ultimately being defeated by [[Captain Pikachu]]'s {{m|Thunder Punch}}. Omastar's known moves are {{m|Rock Blast}} and {{m|Water Gun}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Hunter |pkmn=Toxtricity |type1=Electric |type2=Poison |img=Pokémon hunter Toxtricity Mudsdale Omastar.png |epnum=HZ035 |epname=The Wild Pair, Friede and Cap! |vajp= |vaen= |desc={{p|Toxtricity}} is one of the hunter's only known Pokémon. It was used to battle against [[Friede]], [[Liko]], and [[Roy]], ultimately being defeated by [[Captain Pikachu]]'s {{m|Thunder Punch}}. Toxtricity's known moves are {{m|Acid Spray}}, {{m|Acid}}, and {{m|Thunder Shock}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Hunter |pkmn=Mudsdale |type1=Ground |img=Pokémon hunter Toxtricity Mudsdale Omastar.png |epnum=HZ035 |epname=The Wild Pair, Friede and Cap! |vajp= |vaen= |desc={{p|Mudsdale}} is one of the hunter's only known Pokémon. It was used to battle against [[Friede]], [[Liko]], and [[Roy]], ultimately being defeated when [[Captain Pikachu]]'s {{m|Thunder Punch}} sent {{p|Omastar}} and {{p|Toxtricity}} flying into it, sending them all into the cage used to hold the Pokémon the hunters had captured.
